017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.runreport;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.rest.server.runreport.ReportJson.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.rest.server.runreport.ReportText.*;
021
022import java.nio.file.*;
023import java.util.*;
024import java.util.stream.*;
025
026import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.runreport.RunEvent.*;
027
028/**
029 * Reads Jest's <c>--json</c> output.
030 *
031 * <p>
032 * The framework key is <c>jest</c>.  A test file that failed to run (no assertions, a non-empty message) becomes one
033 * <c>error</c> test named <c>(suite failed to run)</c>, so a crashed file is a visible red block rather than silence.
034 * ANSI colour codes are stripped from messages.  A truncated file yields no tests and a warning.
035 */
036public final class JestJsonReportReader implements ReportReader {
037
038   private static final String CRASHED = "(suite failed to run)";
039
040   @Override /* ReportReader */
041   public String fw() {
042      return "jest";
043   }
044
045   @Override /* ReportReader */
046   @SuppressWarnings({
047      "java:S135", // Guard clauses keep the loop readable.
048      "java:S3776" // Walking files and their assertions is inherently nested.
049   })
050   public ReportResult read(Path path, ReportLimits lim) {
051      var out = new ReportBuilder();
052      var root = readRoot(path, lim, out);
053      if (root == null)
054         return out.build(fw());
055
056      var files = new ArrayList<String>();
057      var rows = new ArrayList<ReportTest>();
058      var rowFiles = new ArrayList<String>();
059      for (var tr : list(root.get("testResults"))) {
060         var file = map(tr);
061         if (file == null)
062            continue;
063         var raw = str(file.get("name")) == null ? "(unknown file)" : str(file.get("name"));
064         if (! files.contains(raw))
065            files.add(raw);
066         var assertions = list(file.get("assertionResults"));
067         var fileMsg = str(file.get("message"));
068         if (assertions.isEmpty() && "failed".equals(str(file.get("status"))) && fileMsg != null && ! fileMsg.isBlank()) {
069            if (rows.size() >= lim.maxTests()) {
070               out.truncated = true;
071               out.warnings.add("report truncated at " + lim.maxTests() + " tests");
072               break;
073            }
074            var body = stripAnsi(fileMsg).strip();
075            rows.add(new ReportTest(null, CRASHED, TestStatus.ERROR, null, clip(firstLine(body), lim.maxMsgChars()), clip(body, lim.maxTraceChars())));
076            rowFiles.add(raw);
077            continue;
078         }
079         if (! addAssertions(assertions, raw, lim, out, rows, rowFiles))
080            break;
081      }
082      var display = stripCommonDir(files);
083      for (var i = 0; i < rows.size(); i++) {
084         var r = rows.get(i);
085         var suite = clip(display.get(files.indexOf(rowFiles.get(i))), lim.maxNameChars());
086         out.tests.add(new ReportTest(suite, r.name(), r.status(), r.ms(), r.msg(), r.trace()));
087      }
088      return out.build(fw());
089   }
090
091   // Returns false when the test limit was reached.
092   private static boolean addAssertions(List<?> assertions, String raw, ReportLimits lim, ReportBuilder out, List<ReportTest> rows, List<String> rowFiles) {
093      for (var a : assertions) {
094         var am = map(a);
095         if (am == null)
096            continue;
097         if (rows.size() >= lim.maxTests()) {
098            out.truncated = true;
099            out.warnings.add("report truncated at " + lim.maxTests() + " tests");
100            return false;
101         }
102         rows.add(assertion(am, lim));
103         rowFiles.add(raw);
104      }
105      return true;
106   }
107
108   private static ReportTest assertion(Map<String,Object> a, ReportLimits lim) {
109      var name = str(a.get("fullName"));
110      if (name == null || name.isEmpty()) {
111         var parts = list(a.get("ancestorTitles")).stream().filter(String.class::isInstance).map(String.class::cast)
112            .collect(Collectors.toCollection(ArrayList::new));
113         var title = str(a.get("title"));
114         if (title != null)
115            parts.add(title);
116         name = String.join(" ", parts);
117      }
118      var status = switch (String.valueOf(a.get("status"))) {
119         case "passed" -> TestStatus.PASS;
120         case "failed" -> TestStatus.FAIL;
121         default -> TestStatus.SKIP;
122      };
123      String msg = null;
124      String trace = null;
125      var fm = list(a.get("failureMessages")).stream().filter(String.class::isInstance).map(String.class::cast)
126         .map(ReportText::stripAnsi).toList();
127      if (! fm.isEmpty()) {
128         var first = firstLine(fm.get(0).strip());
129         msg = first.isEmpty() ? null : clip(first, lim.maxMsgChars());
130         trace = clip(String.join("\n", fm), lim.maxTraceChars());
131      }
132      return new ReportTest(null, clip(name, lim.maxNameChars()), status, ms(a.get("duration")), msg, trace);
133   }
134
135   private static String firstLine(String s) {
136      return RunViewChecks.firstLine(s);
137   }
138}
